confirmedScope: The implemented foundation covers the whole Studio composition: ordinary documents, settings, project definitions/templates, World, resources/export and the existing build workbench.

Project requirements are additive versioned data. Unknown 3D and author Rust capabilities remain missing with local diagnostics; plain text, custom types and drama scenes stay ordinary editable documents.
Registered module contribution and host capability flags do not mean executable tools are installed or identified, and grant no source-write, process, filesystem or renderer authority.

The docs explicitly retain the main document lifecycle, World controller internals and combined build surface as further decomposition work; there is no claim that every functional area has been fully detached.
The build preview remains subject to the existing build area availability; it is not described as a fully independent preview provider.
There is no new 3D editor, dynamic plugin loader, hot unload, automatic migration, native GUI/provider, author Rust compiler or new install/device acceptance.

The optional native profile is copied and retained; absent builtin package serialization/digests stay compatible. Integer-semantic digest normalization only changes a private digest copy and does not rewrite author profile values.
Unpublished working-tree changes and older published/installed versions remain separate across current docs.
